capabilities: Automatically sync parent and child checkboxes
extras: Only works on standard Markdown files (.md) and does not modify embedded Canvas nodes.
intentEvidence: Automatically sync parent and child checkboxes inside your Markdown files in Obsidian.
problem: Manually maintaining the status of parent tasks when child checkboxes in nested Markdown lists are modified is cumbersome.
summary: A tool that automatically synchronizes the state of parent and child checkboxes within hierarchical Markdown task lists in Obsidian.
